2020 Q1.gq: We have reset our financial expectations for the year based on that level of market impact and now expect revenue to be down 11% to 17% from last year versus our previous guidance for growth of 4% to 8%.

2020 Q2.gq: Looking at the company's performance in the first half of the year and the outlook for the second half, we are raising 2020 revenue guidance from a range of down 11% to 17% to a new range of down 10% to 15%.

2020 Q3.gq: Looking at the company’s performance year-to-date and outlook for the fourth quarter, we are raising our 2020 revenue guidance from a decline of 10% to 15% to a decline of 5% to 9% for the year.

2020 Q4.gq: For the company overall in 2021, we are reiterating guidance.

2021 Q1.gq: We are also raising free cash flow guidance to $375 million for the full year.

2021 Q2.gq: We raised guidance for adjusted EPS from continuing operations to $12.10 to $12.70 for the year.

2021 Q3.gq: We now expect a benefit of $130 million from price for the year, up from prior guidance of $110 million benefit.

2021 Q4.gq: And we are raising our guidance for GAAP and adjusted EPS from continuing operations from a range of $13.40 to $14.40, to a new range of $13.50 to $14.50.

2022 Q1.gq: With a second round of price increases announced for 2022, we now expect price to be a benefit of $335 million for the year and 8% yield and this is up from our prior guidance of $235 million.

2022 Q2.gq: However, we are still seeing inflationary pressures on components and other materials and now expect a $100 million headwind, compared to prior guidance of a $70 million headwind for other components.

2022 Q3.gq: However, we are still seeing inflationary pressures on components and other materials and now expect $120 million headwind compared to prior guidance of a $100 million headwind.

2022 Q4.bq: Given this, our 2022 free cash flow was $203 million, which was below our expectations.

2023 Q2.gq: In Commercial, we now anticipate sales to be up low double digits for the full year versus prior expectations of high single digits to low double-digit sales increase.

2023 Q3.gq: Our guidance for capital expenditures is unchanged from our prior guide at $250 million, and this includes our investment in the new Saltillo factory and refrigerant transition-related investments.

2025 Q1.gq: Based on the first quarter results and the latest end market outlook, we are confirming our revenue growth of 2% and raising the lower end of our adjusted EPS guidance to $22.25 from $22.

2025 Q2.gq: Starting with revenue, we now expect full-year revenue to grow by 3%, up from our previous guidance of 2%.

2025 Q3.gq: Starting with revenue, we now expect full-year revenue to decline by 1% compared to our previous guidance of 3% growth.

2025 Q4.bq: Free cash flow for 2025 was $640 million, above our prior guidance of $550 million.
